scope: Six unchanged n83 prime m2 ell27 presentations. Exact highest-form FFD and a separate conditional strict filtered witness; no global LFD upper or exact LFD.

directories.inputs/KEY/input.json: Immutable typed input, target, field, selector and actual point-manifest identity
directories.inputs/KEY/system.sing: Unchanged complete original equation source, validated byte for byte
directories.results/primality.json: Lucas certificate for the retained 83-bit prime with full p-1 factorization
directories.results/KEY/certificate.json: Full source validation; selector weights/inverses; exact rank certificates; direct and formula pairings; degree claims and exceptional-target rule; factor hashes and witness circuit
directories.results/KEY/A0.poly: H: product of thirteen disjoint normalized-variable differences
directories.results/KEY/A1.poly: Complete sparse normal form of H*X under z_i^2=w_i*z_i
directories.results/KEY/A2.poly: Complete sparse normal form of H*X^2 under the same selector equations
directories.results/KEY/B0.poly: Complete sparse normal form of t^2*Y^2+(-2at-4b)*Y+(a^2-4bt)
directories.results/KEY/B2.poly: Complete sparse normal form of Y^2-2t*Y+t^2
directories.results/summary.json: All six source/base identities and separate FFD, strict filtered fall and LFD fields
directories.controls.json: 36 independent expanded-polynomial comparisons; 12 small dense-closure comparisons including positive and exceptional targets; inherited explicit small rank controls
directories.manifest.sha256: Hash of every sealed raw payload; verify before and after replay

fields.encoding: u32 little-endian maximum squarefree degree; zero polynomial convention is zero

polynomial_file.record: u64 little-endian squarefree variable mask, followed by u128 little-endian coefficient
polynomial_file.invariants: Exactly header+24*count bytes; strictly increasing masks below 2^ell; coefficients in [1,p-1]; no omitted nonzero terms; degree equals maximum mask popcount. Each factor uses local indices0..26.

reconstruction.coordinate_map: A local variable z_i=w_i*v_i. B local variable u_i=w_i*v_(27+i). Original v variables are Boolean selectors; normalized squares satisfy z_i^2=w_i*z_i and u_i^2=w_i*u_i.
reconstruction.witness: g = A0 tensor B0 + A1 tensor B1 + A2 tensor B2. To expand, shift each B mask left by27, OR it with an A mask, multiply coefficients modulo p, and combine equal masks. Retaining factors is exact, not a sampling or truncation.
reconstruction.source_relation: g=NF(H*S3(X,Y,t)), where H=A0,X=sum z_i,Y=sum u_i. This gives a degree-at-most17 derivation from the original system.
reconstruction.functional: On the degree16 part, multiply by H in the square-zero associated graded algebra and extract the coefficient of all27 A variables and B variables0,1. Compute directly by complementary A masks and each B coefficient at mask3.

claim_fields.first_fall_degree: Nontrivial highest-form syzygy degree using the written Koszul/annihilator argument and certified multiplication ranks
claim_fields.strict_filtered_fall_verified: True only when the directly computed functional is nonzero and matches the algebraic formula
claim_fields.first_strict_filtered_fall_degree: Exact first strict filtered fall when the nonzero witness and complete lower-space argument apply; otherwise null
claim_fields.last_fall_lower_bound: Strict witness degree when verified; otherwise null, not inferred merely from highest-form FFD
claim_fields.exceptional_delta: S-2t modulo p. Zero makes this strict-witness test inconclusive, not a nonexistence result.

replay: Recompute complete source validation, primality, ranks, every sparse factor coefficient and direct pairing; require byte-identical factor files and identical JSON certificates/summary. Replay writes no dataset file.
review_boundary: Producer and replay checks are not independent scientific review or a full Lean proof. Original-top regularity, solving degree, FFD and LFD remain distinct. No elite-base or ECDLP recovery claim.
